sections.welcomeP1: Hey, welcome to the {{appName}} demo site! This is an open-source project, and we hope you have a great time here.
sections.welcomeP2: When you use our service, it means you agree to follow these simple rules.
sections.whatWeProvideP1: We are a magnet search tool that helps you quickly find the resources you want.
sections.whatWeProvideP2: Please note that we do not store or host any resource files — we only provide search and link services.
sections.userResponsibilityTitle: 3. As a user, you need to
sections.userResponsibility1: Comply with laws and regulations, do not search for or obtain illegal content
sections.userResponsibility2: Do not abuse our service, such as batch requests or automated operations
sections.userResponsibility3: Protect your account information and be responsible for your own actions
sections.openSourceP1: This project is open source! You can view the code, make suggestions, or even contribute your own effort.
sections.openSourceP2: But please respect intellectual property rights — do not copy or modify it for commercial use without authorization.
sections.changesP1: As a demo project, we may adjust features or the interface at any time.
sections.changesP2: If you have any good suggestions, feel free to tell us!
sections.disclaimerP1: Since this is a demo project, we are not responsible for any consequences arising from use.
sections.disclaimerP2: Please use it carefully and make sure the resources you obtain are legal.

sections.valuePrivacyP1: Hey, we are the open-source team behind {{appName}}! Although this is a demo project, we still value your privacy.
sections.valuePrivacyP2: This policy will tell you how we handle your information and what rights you have.
sections.collectInfo1: Account information: username, email address (used for registration and login)
sections.collectInfo2: Search history: keywords and records you have searched
sections.collectInfo3: Usage data: access time, device info, IP address (used to optimize the service)
sections.useInfo1: Provide and improve our search service
sections.useInfo2: Verify your identity and ensure account security
sections.useInfo3: Send important notifications (such as verification codes)
sections.useInfo4: Analyze usage and optimize the user experience
sections.noShareTitle: 4. We will not share your information
sections.noShareP1: As an open-source project, we respect your privacy. We will not share your personal information with third parties unless:
sections.noShare1: You explicitly authorize us to do so
sections.noShare3: To protect our rights and safety
sections.protectInfoP1: Although it is a demo project, we have taken basic security measures to protect your information, including encrypted storage and access control.
sections.dataRetentionP1: We will retain your personal information for as long as necessary, and delete or anonymize it after the necessary period expires.
sections.yourRights1: Access and view your personal information
sections.yourRights2: Modify or delete your personal information
sections.yourRights4: Restrict the processing of personal information
sections.policyUpdatesP1: As an open-source project, we may update the privacy policy as needed. Changes will be published on the website.
